title: The Orbital Canticle
author: Barış Kısır
premise: In 2210, the orbital monastery of St. Elara has sung the same daily canticle to Earth for two hundred years — a hymn of blessing transmitted from the Lagrange point. When the canticle suddenly changes, novice Sister Vesna discovers the monastery has been singing a warning, not a blessing, and the change is a distress call from Earth itself.
